question: Oklahoma Governor Republican Primary Winner
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Republican Primary for Governor of Oklahoma, scheduled to take place on June 16, 2026. Resolution will be based on the overall winner of the primary, including any potential second round or run-off.

If no 2026 Oklahoma Gubernatorial Republican Primary takes place, this market will resolve to “Other.”

The resolution source for this market will be the first official announcement of the results from the Oklahoma Republican Party; however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I have enough sourced material dated on or before 2026-08-20 and am writing up the findings now. I'm leaving out anything published after that cutoff.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names the Oklahoma Republican Party's first official announcement as the source. I did not fetch an OKGOP page. The working data source is the Oklahoma State Election Board's results, as reported by AP.
- 2026-06-16/17: In the first round, Gentner Drummond got 105,787 votes and Mike Mazzei got 104,629, each just over 25% in a nine-candidate field. Neither reached a majority, so the race went to an Aug. 25 runoff. [ICT](https://ictnews.org/news/oklahoma-governors-race-will-see-republican-runoff-following-primaries/), [Public Radio Tulsa](https://www.publicradiotulsa.org/local-regional/2026-06-17/mazzei-drummond-advance-to-runoff-election-for-oklahoma-governor)
- Chip Keating came third with under 20%. I could not find percentages for the other six candidates, including Charles McCall and Ryan Walters. [Public Radio Tulsa](https://www.publicradiotulsa.org/local-regional/2026-06-17/mazzei-drummond-advance-to-runoff-election-for-oklahoma-governor)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-20 nothing is settled. The race is a two-way runoff, Drummond vs. Mazzei, on 2026-08-25. That makes Keating, Mitchell Haynes, McCall, Merrick, Walters and "Other" effectively ruled out.
- The Democratic nominee is Cyndi Munson. That doesn't matter for this question. [ICT](https://ictnews.org/news/oklahoma-governors-race-will-see-republican-runoff-following-primaries/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-18: Trump renewed his "COMPLETE and TOTAL" endorsement of Mazzei on Truth Social. He attacked Drummond over past donations, his response to Trump's impeachment, his legal challenge to the religious charter school, and his opposition to the proposed aluminum plant in Inola. [News9](https://www.news9.com/politics/trump-renews-support-for-mazzei-criticizes-drummond-in-oklahoma-governor-runoff)
- 2026-08-11/12: A CHS & Associates (Pat McFerron) poll of 600 likely voters, finished Aug. 6, has the race tied at 44-44. Drummond leads by 2 when undecideds are removed. Mazzei does best with Trump-aligned Republicans and Drummond with traditional Republicans. [News9](https://www.news9.com/oklahoma-elections/oklahoma-runoff-election-governor-drummond-mazzei-poll), [OKCFox](https://okcfox.com/news/local/mcferron-poll-drummond-and-mazzei-deadlocked-at-44-in-gop-governor-runoff), [KSWO](https://www.kswo.com/2026/08/12/new-polling-shows-oklahoma-gubernatorial-race-dead-heat-ahead-primary-runoff/)
- 2026-08-06: KGOU says the New York Times' poll tracking shows one poll with Mazzei up 6 and another with Drummond up 2. A runoff debate took place in early August. [KGOU](https://www.kgou.org/politics-and-government/2026-08-06/polls-prediction-markets-and-oklahoma-politics-what-you-need-to-know-this-election-season)
- 2026-06 (after the primary): A Pulse poll for Club for Growth had Mazzei ahead 44% to 38%. Club for Growth backs Mazzei, so treat it as a partisan poll. [Club for Growth](https://www.clubforgrowth.org/okgov-primary-runoff-poll-shows-mazzei-up-6-over-drummond/)
- Arkansas Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders also endorsed Mazzei; I don't have the exact date. [News9](https://www.news9.com/oklahoma-politics/arkansas-governor-endorses-mike-mazzei)
- 2026-05-29: Trump first endorsed Mazzei, less than three weeks before the primary. [KRMG](https://www.krmg.com/2026/05/29/president-donald-trump-endorses-and-oklahoma-gubernatorial-candidate/), [NonDoc](https://nondoc.com/2026/05/29/tremendous-honor-donald-trump-endorses-mike-mazzei-for-governor-of-oklahoma/)

## 4. Base rates
- The closest Oklahoma precedent is 2018: outsider Kevin Stitt beat establishment figure Mick Cornett in the GOP governor runoff after finishing second in the first round. That's from my background knowledge; I didn't search for it.
- Trump-endorsed candidates usually win open-seat Republican primaries and runoffs, but not always. I found no systematic runoff-specific rate.
- The first-round gap was tiny (about 1,141 votes out of roughly 403,000). That means the runoff turns on where Keating's, McCall's and Walters' voters go. I found no data on that.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-01: Kalshi's GOP nominee market had Mazzei at about 80% and Drummond at about 18%. [KGOU](https://www.kgou.org/politics-and-government/2026-08-06/polls-prediction-markets-and-oklahoma-politics-what-you-need-to-know-this-election-season)
- 2026-08-04: Kalshi was at roughly 75/25 for Mazzei, with nearly $1M traded. [KGOU](https://www.kgou.org/politics-and-government/2026-08-06/polls-prediction-markets-and-oklahoma-politics-what-you-need-to-know-this-election-season)
- Market page: [Kalshi KXGOVOKNOMR-26](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxgovoknomr/gov-ok-nom-r/kxgovoknomr-26). I couldn't find a Kalshi price dated Aug. 19-20, or any Polymarket or Manifold price dated on or before 2026-08-20.
- The markets (about 75-80% Mazzei) favor him much more than the public polls do (roughly even).

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-25: Runoff election day. Results come in that night, and the AP call and OKGOP announcement would follow. Resolution is expected around 2026-08-26. [NewsOn6 runoff guide](https://www.newson6.com/oklahoma-politics/oklahoma-runoff-election-guide)
- Before that: final days of ads and possible further Trump posts or a rally. With the polls this close, a very narrow result could mean a recount or certification delay. The State Election Board certifies results after the county canvass.
